note: Nine core entries used by the N-scaling case. Four independent models of one OTN network each bind to these, with different local labels.

entries.label: link termination
entries.definition: The point where a link terminates on a node.

entries.label: connection service
entries.definition: An end-to-end service across the network.

entries.label: multiplex structure
entries.definition: How a signal is multiplexed into a server layer.

entries.label: switching constraint
entries.definition: Which ports may cross-connect within a node.

entries.label: topology
entries.definition: The graph of nodes and links.

entries.label: connection endpoint
entries.definition: An endpoint of a connection within a node.
